description: List the MCP servers on this ManyCP account. Each comes with its id and slug (every other tool takes either one as `server`), its repo and version, and a one-line status across the directories that fit it, for example '3 live, 1 PR open, 16 not started'. Read-only, works on every plan. Call this first when the user says 'my server' and you do not know which one they mean. Use get_server for the detail of one.
name: list_servers
title: List my servers
